records.title: awful app.
records.review:
The app is clunky and has horrific UX. It’s unresponsive and is not as reactive as other apps like Monzo and Revolut. The home page is cluttered with a lot of stuff that’s totally irrelevant and the frequently used features are buried deep down. If I need to view my card details, it takes forever. 

Although this is my main account, I instantly transfer my money to either my Monzo or Revolut account because they’re so much more user friendly. 

Suggestions; make it easier to find my card details. Name cards. Create new, online only ones for secure shopping. Create money pots. Imported the UI too; add some colour and graphics in there, it’s miserable to look at.

Also, it’s now got to the point that when I want to log in or use it it takes ages to load and often crashes. I don’t have this issue with any other banking app, so it isn’t due to signal.
